_about: Class abilities: a free action with a cooldown, at Lv 1, 5 and 20, and each ascension's own version. statuses go on the user; params tune them; effect names a special action. From the old game's AB2 table.

tiers.name: Bloodlust
tiers.text: 3 turns: cloaked even while attacking, +3 move, +50% crit chance.

tiers.name: Bloodlust+
tiers.text: 3 turns: cloaked, +3 move, +60% crit chance, and crits deal +25% more.

tiers.name: Bloodlust II
tiers.text: 4 turns: cloaked, +4 move, +70% crit chance, crits +25%, and each kill recharges Cloak.

Blade Dancer.name: Crimson Bloodlust
Blade Dancer.text: 4 turns: cloaked, +5 move, every hit crits, crits +50%, Cloak recharges on kills, and each kill adds a turn.

Phantom.name: Shadow Clones
Phantom.text: Summon 2 decoy clones next to you for 3 turns. Enemies prefer to attack them, and a clone that's destroyed explodes.

Viper.name: Death Mark
Viper.text: Mark one enemy for 3 turns: it takes +50% damage from your party, and when it dies its poison spreads to every enemy within 2 tiles.

tiers.name: Beast Mode
tiers.text: 3 turns: +7 move, attacks add 25% of their damage as fire, 35% chance to burn for 3 turns.

tiers.name: Beast Mode+
tiers.text: 3 turns: +7 move, 30% added fire, 45% burn chance.

tiers.name: Beast Mode II
tiers.text: 4 turns: +7 move, 35% added fire, 55% burn chance, and attacks splash 50% to adjacent enemies.

Frost Wyrm.name: Glacial Scales
Frost Wyrm.text: 3 turns: ranged attacks can't hurt you, melee damage to you is cut by 40%, and melee attackers are rooted.

Inferno Rider.name: Inferno Beast
Inferno Rider.text: 4 turns: +8 move, 50% added fire, attacks always burn, splash, and every tile you end on burns for 2 turns.

Storm Dragoon.name: Sky Lord
Storm Dragoon.text: Take off (ends your turn): untargetable until your next turn, then Crash Down on any open tile within 8 for 2.5× damage to everything within 2 tiles, shocking them.

tiers.name: Quick Draw
tiers.text: This turn, fire two different skills, one from each gun, at one target or two.

tiers.name: Quick Draw+
tiers.text: Two different skills this turn, and the second deals +25%.

tiers.name: Quick Draw II
tiers.text: Two skills this turn (the same skill is allowed), both +20%.

Bounty Hunter.name: Wanted Poster
Bounty Hunter.text: Mark one enemy until it dies: your shots at it can't miss and deal +50%. Killing it recharges Wanted Poster and gives triple gold and a guaranteed item.

Outlaw.name: Dead Man's Hand
Outlaw.text: Three skills this turn (repeats allowed), each +25%, at any mix of targets.

Trickshot.name: Overwatch
Trickshot.text: Ends your turn aiming a 4-tile cone. During the enemy turn you shoot every enemy that moves inside it, at 70% damage.

tiers.name: Enlightenment
tiers.text: 2 turns: healing +30%, and every heal reaches the whole party.

tiers.name: Enlightenment+
tiers.text: 2 turns: healing +40%, party heals, and each heal removes one debuff.

tiers.name: Enlightenment II
tiers.text: 3 turns: healing +50%, party heals, and each heal removes all debuffs.

Oracle.name: Time Shift
Oracle.text: One ally acts again this turn (move and action refreshed) and gains Haste.

Plague Doctor.name: Plague Bloom
Plague Doctor.text: 3 turns: each heal also deals half its amount as dark damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of the healed ally, and poisons them.

Saint.name: Divine Choir
Saint.text: 3 turns: healing +60%, party heals that cleanse everything, overheal shields doubled, and one fallen ally is revived right away.

tiers.name: Vow of Honor
tiers.text: 3 turns: +30% attack, +5 move.

tiers.name: Vow of Honor+
tiers.text: 3 turns: +35% attack, +5 move, and charge bonus +50%.

tiers.name: Vow of Honor II
tiers.text: 3 turns: +40% attack, +6 move, charge bonus +50%, and allies next to you get +15% attack.

Black Knight.name: Oath of Ruin
Black Knight.text: 3 turns: every kill gives you a full extra turn (move and attack) and stuns enemies within 2 tiles.

Storm Rider.name: Thunderous Oath
Storm Rider.text: 4 turns: +50% attack, +7 move, charge bonus doubled, and adjacent allies get +20% attack.

Templar.name: Sacred Vow
Templar.text: 3 turns: half of all damage aimed at allies within 2 tiles hits you instead, you heal 10% of max HP each turn, and those allies get +20% DEF.

tiers.name: Inner Element
tiers.text: Next attack +30%, can't miss, and always applies its element's status.

tiers.name: Inner Element+
tiers.text: Next attack +40%, can't miss, and its status lasts 1 turn longer.

tiers.name: Inner Element II
tiers.text: Next attack +50%, can't miss, longer status, and its area grows 1 tile (single-target spells splash to adjacent enemies).

Cryomancer.name: Absolute Freeze
Cryomancer.text: Freeze one enemy within 6 tiles for 2 turns: it can't act, takes +50% damage from your party, and can't be healed.

Pyromancer.name: Firestorm Field
Pyromancer.text: Set a 3×3 area within 5 tiles ablaze for 3 turns: enemies in it burn every turn, and you deal +20% fire damage while it lasts.

Stormcaller.name: Elemental Overload
Stormcaller.text: Your next 2 spells get +60%, can't miss, longer status and +1 tile area.

tiers.name: Hunter's Eye
tiers.text: This turn: +3 range, and your next skill (not ultimates) hits up to 3 enemies at +30%.

tiers.name: Hunter's Eye+
tiers.text: This turn: +3 range, next skill hits up to 4 enemies at +35%.

tiers.name: Hunter's Eye II
tiers.text: This turn: +4 range, next skill hits up to 5 enemies at +40% and ignores 30% DEF.

Sniper.name: Deadeye Focus
Sniper.text: Stay still this turn: your next shot can hit any enemy on the map, always crits for 3× damage, and ignores all DEF.

Tempest Archer.name: Storm Eye
Tempest Archer.text: For 2 turns: +5 range, and each skill hits every enemy in range (up to 6) at +50%, ignoring 30% DEF.

Trapper.name: Snare Field
Trapper.text: Hide 3 traps on tiles within 6. An enemy that steps on one is rooted and poisoned for 3 turns and takes +30% damage from you.

tiers.name: Iron Maiden
tiers.text: Next attack adds your full DEF to its damage. +25% DEF for 3 turns.

tiers.name: Iron Maiden+
tiers.text: Next attack adds 1.5× your DEF. +30% DEF for 3 turns.

tiers.name: Iron Maiden II
tiers.text: Next attack adds 2× your DEF and stuns. +35% DEF for 3 turns.

Guardian.name: Frost Bulwark
Guardian.text: For 3 turns, allies within 2 tiles of you get +30% DEF, and any enemy that hits one of them is rooted.

Juggernaut.name: Unbroken Maiden
Juggernaut.text: Next attack adds 2.5× your DEF, stuns, and hits every adjacent enemy. +50% DEF for 3 turns, and the first killing blow on you leaves you at 1 HP.

Warlord.name: War Banner
Warlord.text: Plant a banner on a tile within 3: for 3 turns, allies within 3 tiles of it get +20% damage and +1 move, and enemies in range burn each turn.

tiers.name: Double Strike
tiers.text: Your next skill (not ultimates) hits twice.

tiers.name: Double Strike+
tiers.text: Next skill hits twice; the second hit can't miss and deals +15%.

tiers.name: Triple Strike
tiers.text: Next skill hits three times; the extra hits can't miss.

Berserker.name: Blood Frenzy
Berserker.text: Spend 20% of your HP: for 3 turns, +50% damage and 25% life steal. Each kill adds a turn.

Duelist.name: Flurry of Blades
Duelist.text: Next skill hits four times, extra hits can't miss, +15% crit chance per hit, and Riposte counters hit twice this turn.

Paladin.name: Oath of Protection
Paladin.text: For 2 turns, enemies within 4 tiles must attack you. You take 30% less damage and heal 10% of max HP each time you're hit.

tiers.name: Poison Ivy
tiers.text: 2 turns: every hit makes the target Immobile for 2 turns and applies Ivy (−30% ATK and DEF), stacking.

tiers.name: Poison Ivy+
tiers.text: 3 turns: Immobile and Ivy, and Ivy also poisons.

tiers.name: Poison Ivy II
tiers.text: 3 turns: Immobile, poisoning Ivy at −40%, and each hit spreads Ivy to one enemy next to the target.

Blood Witch.name: Blood Pact
Blood Witch.text: 3 turns: move to any open tile, heal for 20% of all damage you deal, and every hit causes Heavy Bleed (5 turns, double damage) whose damage heals you.

Hex Queen.name: Queen's Garden
Hex Queen.text: 3 turns: Immobile, poisoning Ivy at −50%, spreading to every enemy next to the target, and all your debuffs last 1 turn longer.

Necromancer.name: Grave Bloom
Necromancer.text: Raise a skeleton for every monster killed on this floor. For 3 turns every new kill rises too. Skeletons fight on their own for the rest of the floor and explode when destroyed, poisoning and applying Ivy to adjacent enemies.

crashDown.name: Crash Down
crashDown.text: Land on any open tile within 8: 2.5× damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and shock them.
